title: pholidocarpus rumphii

It is native to the tropical regions of the Pacific Islands and is valued for its medicinal properties. The plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its health benefits of reducing inflammation and acting as an antimicrobial agent.
